note: ONE source of trigger patterns for the evaluation->obligation compiler. Read by modules/daif/turn_obligations.py (Python) and by the E3 Stop hook (Node). Regexes use only syntax common to Python re and JS RegExp; flags are the letters i/u only. scope=table_row applies to lines starting with '|'; scope=sentence applies to the other lines split on sentence ends. The first matching pattern in list order wins per line/sentence. A sentence also refused by the extractor's wish clause, or lacking a commitment frame when frame=true, is dropped. 'exclude' vetoes a match (zero counts are not failures).
